independent_reviews.scope: Metadata, detector labeling, training setup, benefit/harm structure, held-out model split, target-specific validation and limitations.
findings: 726 fitting runs through 268M; 74 held-out runs at 477M/973M.
Human budget held fixed while AI additions vary; human-token equivalence can change sign.
Mixed validation disguises human-target harm in the reported small English model setting; not proof all synthetic data damages downstream capability.
Appendix D.1 also compares candidate functional forms at the held-out 477M/973M sizes, so the manuscript does not describe the reported error as a final test independent of form selection.

independent_reviews.scope: Abstract, measurement-efficiency validation, selection results and relevant appendix evidence.
findings: Transfer of functional form is distinct from transfer of coefficients; settings refit coefficients.
Half the configuration measurements is not half total GPU time.
Numerical prediction did not beat fixed method preference for QA in the tested selection panels.
Capability-specific teacher-forced loss is not equivalent to generated exact-match accuracy.

independent_reviews.scope: Metadata, selection/conversion results, retained-pool replay and accounting/failure details in Appendix J.2.
findings: 500 scheduled coding cells = five models times 100 tasks, with 498 retained pools.
Post-hoc output-aware fallback preserves spent judge costs; empty-choice failures differ from incorrect candidate generation.
Public examples choose candidates without hidden correctness labels; logical API savings exclude separately recorded local execution expense.
Counterfactual accounting on existing candidates is not an independently rerun matched-budget deployment comparison.
